selected_case_apd_branch_probe.selection_formula: For UN.5 class totals Ic,Uc and episode u/f counts: delta=100/K*((Ic-Iu+If)/(Uc-Uu+Uf)-Ic/Uc). Each replacement is evaluated against the unchanged full domain; contributions are not additive.
selected_case_apd_branch_probe.selection_order: COCO and ISIC separately; descending delta; str(index) ascending tie-break; retain first three distinct row.query_rgb_hash values.
selected_case_apd_branch_probe.branch_formula: Raw O/24 tokenwise F.normalize(p=2); unit mean reference FG vector mu; unprojected unit-query global mean q; s_sem=dot(mu,q)/(norm(q)+1e-6); apply iff s_sem<0.8; empty nearest64 FG returns True.

official_source.unused_for_boolean: s_pos is computed but not used by this one-reference decision; no basis/projection loaded or applied in this probe.
